name: Summon a Sweetheart
source:
This is a short visual novel-esque game about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all! 

In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result. 

[Edited from [url=https://inkyblinkyarts.itch.io/summon-a-sweetheart]itch.io[/url]]
